name: pacs.008 to MT103 Field Mapping
description: Maps ISO 20022 pacs.008 FIToFICstmrCdtTrf fields to SWIFT MT103 message structure for customer credit transfers according to CBPR+ reverse transformation specification

tasks.name: Validate Preconditions
tasks.description: Validate preconditions for pacs.008 to MT103 transformation including currency validation

rules.message: T20054: Commodities currencies not allowed in Field 32A

tasks.name: Extract Temporary Variables
tasks.description: Extract sender and receiver BIC codes from header for use in translation rules

tasks.name: Construct SWIFT Headers
tasks.description: Build SWIFT MT103 basic and application headers using sender and receiver BICs

tasks.name: Map Mandatory MT103 Fields
tasks.description: Map mandatory MT103 fields including user header and core transaction fields

tasks.name: Map Instructed Amount and Charges
tasks.description: Map optional fields 33B (instructed amount) and 71A (charge bearer)

tasks.name: Map Customer Details
tasks.description: Map ordering customer (50K) and beneficiary customer (59) party information

tasks.name: Map Instruction Codes
tasks.description: Map instruction codes (23E) and sender-to-receiver information (72)

tasks.name: Generate Field Order
tasks.description: Generate the field order array for MT103

tasks.name: Publish MT103 Message
tasks.description: Generate the complete SWIFT MT103 message

tasks.name: Validate Post-conditions
tasks.description: Validate clearing code usage and other post-conditions

rules.message: T20224/T20225: //FW or //RT codes should appear only once and in the first agent field (56a before 57a)
